text_block_list.text:
A fan letter arrived for Transcend. She 
usually reads them the moment they arrive.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hmm~? They said they not only watch my 
races, but they watch my UmaTube channel 
too~.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
You know, the one introducing gadgets... 
that one...

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Hm? There are some characters I can't 
really read~ I'll just go ask Accu-san or 
something.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
We're roommates anyway, so I can write 
back right away, yeah?

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Man, you got me. The person who sent this 
letter is a super old-school listener.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Talk about nostalgic~. Back then, we 
hardly had any subscribers at all.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
"Today's review is on the newest keyboard! 
Just how good does it feel to type on, and 
what's its true potential...!?"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: "Alright then... time to test it out!"

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... The view count is so low. 
Literally no one's watching.

text_block_list.name: A Certain Listener
text_block_list.text:
“Your love for gadgets is so soothing! 
Don't worry about reading this out, just 
keep doing your best!”

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
...Ah. What should I do for my next video 
topic, I wonder~

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
I'm the one being comforted here, you 
know. Back then, and even now.

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text: In that case, the answer is—

text_block_list.name: Transcend
text_block_list.text:
Just like that video that got the most 
views! With the best race ever! ...So emo!
